model: MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) gateway for CAHV / CRHV / QAHV heat pumps and EAHV / EACV e-series chillers
equipment_type: Chiller / heat pump gateway (VRF / split AC gateway)
applies_to: Procon MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) firmware 4.1.0 on Mitsubishi Electric CAHV and CRHV heat pumps, QAHV CO2 heat pumps and EAHV / EACV e-series chillers (master and slave units); holding-register table only.
summary: The Procon MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) is an RS-485 Modbus gateway; its air-to-water (ATW) register tables carry separate applicability columns for the commercial units: CAHV and CRHV heat pumps, QAHV CO2 heat pumps and EAHV / EACV e-series chillers. This map lists the holding registers ticked for those units: on/off, operating mode, water setpoint, capacity mode and ratio, outdoor temperature from the BMS, water inlet/outlet, evaporating, condensing and brine temperatures, compressor frequencies, run states of up to 32 modules, pumps, energy counters and model information.

addressing.note: Every row gives a protocol 'Addr' and a Modicon address (Addr 25 = 40026). The Addr value is the wire address.

source.title: MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) ATW Modbus Register Tables
source.pages: Holding registers pp. 6-31 (CAHV/CRHV/QAHV/EAHV-EACV master and slave applicability columns), notes * ** † †† and #1-#18 pp. 30-31

notes: Only holding registers ticked for at least one of CAHV master/slave, CRHV master/slave, QAHV master or EAHV/EACV master/slave are listed; each description names the units it applies to (m/s = master and slave). The FTC (Ecodan) part of the same tables is a separate file in this library.

Several addresses carry a different name for the commercial units than for FTC (e.g. 40102 'Water Outlet Temperature' instead of 'Flow Temperature', 40031 'Thermo-off Temperature' on QAHV); the commercial name is used here.
Temperatures are x100 (0.01 °C) except outdoor temperatures 40051 and 40100 (x10). Every signed temperature has an unsigned twin at the next address; only the signed versions are listed.
Ticks shown in brackets with note #18 (slave units on 40026, 40027, 40049, 40050) are read-only values.

Setting water temperature (40053) range per the notes: CAHV +30 to +65 °C, CRHV +25 to +65 °C, QAHV +40 to +90 °C, EAHV +30 to +55 °C heating and +5 to +25 °C cooling. Outdoor temperature by BMS (40051): -30 to +50 °C.

Model notes: on CAHV 2013 models Stop and Cooling modes are not supported (CRHV 2013: also Legionella); EAHV 2015 models do not support Stop, Hot Water, No-Voltage Contact and Legionella modes; Emergency/Test Run are not supported on CAHV/CRHV 2013 and EAHV 2015; MRC prohibit bit 4 is not supported on those models; capacity mode is not supported on CAHV 2013; values marked #1 read 0 on CAHV/CRHV 2013 models.
Left out: 40114 (printed '(signed)' but with the unsigned note **), and the input register, coil and discrete input tables, which repeat the same data.
The MRC Prohibit register must not be written to Shizuoka-designed models (note ††).

integration.summary: Read 40014 to confirm an ATW system and 40010 / 40013 for faults. Switch with 40026 and choose the mode with 40027 on the master unit; write the water setpoint at 40053 (x100) and read water outlet / inlet temperatures at 40102 / 40104.
integration.enable: No enable step is described in the register tables; set the gateway's address, baud rate and parity (40005-40007) to match the BMS. See the MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) installation instructions.
quirks: Holding registers are read with FC 03 and written with FC 06 or 16; rows marked READ ONLY cannot be written.
setup: Each A1M+ reads the unit it is connected to; the slave columns show what a gateway on a slave unit can read. Wiring and DIP settings are in the separate A1M+ installation instructions.
gotchas: Run-time hours are split: 40137 holds 0-99 h and 40138 the hundreds (x100 h); total = 40138 x 100 + 40137.
Energy counters 40235-40250 are 0.01 kWh in one register, so they top out at 655.35 kWh; the tables do not say what happens after that.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
